Enter a function as an expression or on the map, and see its groups, minimal SOP and POS, with don't cares. Draft: it changes until Blake approves it.

```{=html}
<div id="kmap"></div>
<noscript><p>The K-map tool needs JavaScript.</p></noscript>
<script type="module">
  import { mount } from "./src/app.js";
  window.kmapTool = mount(document.getElementById("kmap"));
</script>
```
